body:
PR #2821 opened for BUG-2015. Branch claude/bug-2015, head a68cb6ef8056aa3e09be30ca8ea6c237647efa20.

(a) The refusing guard is aida-relay's project-local hook (your BUG-2159 ruling), so AIDA ships the allowance it checks. mirror-sync attests each push in AIDA_MIRROR_SYNC_ATTEST. The new hidden `aida remote mirror-guard-check <remote>` allows a push only when: the remote is a registered mirror and not origin, no ref is a deletion, sha == origin/<default>, and the attestation names exactly that push.
(b) `aida remote mirror` leaves the config uncommitted when HEAD is the default branch and prints the branch + PR route.

Tests: 2 fix tests (each confirmed failing with its fix disabled) and 1 refusal test (local-only sha, origin, unattested, unregistered remote, deletion). I also ran an end-to-end smoke with the real relay guard plus the snippet.
Gates: check-ci-fast, test-touched, check-ci-compile all green.

Still needed in aida-relay before mirror-sync works there: the guard captures stdin first (`refs_all=$(cat)`) and calls
  printf '%s\n' "$refs_all" | aida remote mirror-guard-check "$remote_name" && exit 0
just before it refuses. That needs a lane in aida-relay. Not done here.
subject: PR opened (BUG-2015)
